products.name: Mobile Application Management (MAM) App Protection Policies for BYOD (Microsoft 365 Apps) — Commercial
products.short_description: A repeatable way to stand up App Protection Policies for BYOD in Microsoft Intune — protect corporate data inside the Microsoft 365 apps on unenrolled personal devices, enforced with Conditional Access, without full device management. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Protect corporate data in mobile apps — without managing the whole personal device

Employees want to use Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint on their own phones, and IT wants the data safe — but enrolling personal devices into full MDM is intrusive and slows adoption. Mobile Application Management (MAM) with App Protection Policies is the answer: protect corporate data inside the Microsoft 365 apps (encryption, copy/paste and save-as limits, PIN, selective wipe) on unenrolled BYOD devices, without touching the rest of the phone. This solution gives you a repeatable way to stand up App Protection Policies for BYOD in Microsoft Intune and enforce them with Conditional Access.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how MAM / App Protection Policies (MAM-without-enrollment) work, the data-protection controls (encryption, cut/copy/paste, save-as, PIN, selective wipe), app configuration, and how Conditional Access enforces 'require approved app / app protection policy'.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune with App Protection, Entra ID + Conditional Access, the Microsoft 365 mobile apps, licensing, target user groups, a pilot group) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: create App Protection Policies for iOS and Android, set data-protection and access settings, add app configuration, enforce with a Conditional Access app-protection grant, validate on unenrolled BYOD, then pilot and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — App Protection Policy discovery, per-user/app protection-status validation, a coverage and enforcement report, safe remediation of gaps, and a MAM scope-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Corporate data protected inside the Microsoft 365 apps on personal phones — encryption, data-movement limits, PIN, and selective wipe, enforced by Conditional Access, with no full-device enrollment — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • MAMAPP-Discovery.ps1 — inventory App Protection / App Configuration policies and the CA app-protection grant
    • MAMAPP-Remediation.ps1 — safely assign a MAM App Protection Policy to the scope group
    • MAMAPP-Report.ps1 — coverage and enforcement report for MAM App Protection on BYOD
    • MAMAPP-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — create/verify the BYOD MAM scope groups and preview membership
    • MAMAPP-Validation.ps1 — confirm a user's targeted apps report an App Protection Policy applied

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.

Government / GCC High tenant? A dedicated Government (GCC High) edition of this solution is available — authored for the US sovereign cloud (correct *.us portals, US Gov Graph endpoints, and Commercial-vs-GCC-High feature parity gaps called out).
